dashboard.title: Institutional dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Aggregate view of {n} contracts {scope}: volume, trend and the rate of anomalies flagged by the statistical layer (median + MAD on the log of the amount).
dashboard.bestTitle: Institutions with the strongest procurement record
dashboard.bestNote: Institutions with at least {min} ingested contracts and the lowest share of open statistical anomalies, best first. Not an integrity certificate — just a reading of the same data used across the app.
dashboard.bestEmpty: Not enough institutions with {min}+ contracts for this filter.

heatmap.title: Anomaly rate by country and year
heatmap.note: Each cell is the share of that country's contracts in that year with an open statistical anomaly; the legend maps colors to rates. Hatched cells have fewer than {min} contracts, so their rate is unreliable.
heatmap.empty: No dated contracts to show yet.
